facts.note: At nine, when the temple struck, watches were shown. Ruedi's was exact, the doctor's was two minutes ahead, and Girard would not take his out of his pocket.

Hall clock struck ten while the regulator showed twelve minutes to ten; the master's usual remark about that clock is mentioned; when the temple struck ten, the regulator agreed with the bell exactly. Ruedi was working beside the master in the atelier after dinner.
She was sent downstairs when the regulator showed twenty past ten; the regulator was running and the master was well; she went straight to the kitchen.
That afternoon she saw the master in the kitchen with Rosa's American alarm clock in his hands, laughing, and did not ask why.
When the piano began she looked at Rosa's clock in the kitchen: two minutes to eleven. When the piano stopped it read eleven minutes past eleven.
She stayed in the kitchen with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven.
